summary: The claim opposes limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing the importance of continued funding for broadband access in schools and libraries to ensure access to essential services for the community.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate would eliminate funding for broadband access in schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-rate funding, this will change and access will be denied to college and high school students who come after school and weekends (Lilly Library is the only library in our regional system that is open on Sundays) as well as denied to low income people who use the internet for job searches and job applications, to complete and submit required government forms in addition to accessing online/digital library materials to borrow.
